stagewise_protocol.average_incremental_accuracy: Unweighted mean of stage seen-class balanced accuracies
stagewise_protocol.calibration: Common permanent TRAIN Normal holdout at each stage; Section27.9 Normal-only tau extension for multiclass models; stored strict gate threshold for AA variants
stagewise_protocol.decomposition: For an attack class at its earliest maximum-recall preceding stage: change in unconditional Normal-miss rate plus change in other-attack-family rate equals signed recall loss
stagewise_protocol.forgetting: For each class introduced before the final task: maximum recall over preceding stages minus final recall; unweighted class mean; signed values retained
stagewise_protocol.prior: Original prepared TRAIN class frequencies, including permanently heldout rows; no TEST prior
stagewise_protocol.secondary_old_class_scope: Old attack classes only, excluding Normal
stagewise_protocol.seen_labels: Mask model outputs and TEST rows to the current seen classes
stagewise_protocol.selection: Earliest completed physical source per dataset/method/seed, never by metric

stagewise_protocol.average_incremental_accuracy: Unweighted mean of stage seen-class balanced accuracies
stagewise_protocol.calibration: Common permanent TRAIN Normal holdout at each stage; Section27.9 Normal-only tau extension for multiclass models; stored strict gate threshold for AA variants
stagewise_protocol.decomposition: For an attack class at its earliest maximum-recall preceding stage: change in unconditional Normal-miss rate plus change in other-attack-family rate equals signed recall loss
stagewise_protocol.forgetting: For each class introduced before the final task: maximum recall over preceding stages minus final recall; unweighted class mean; signed values retained
stagewise_protocol.prior: Original prepared TRAIN class frequencies, including permanently heldout rows; no TEST prior
stagewise_protocol.secondary_old_class_scope: Old attack classes only, excluding Normal
stagewise_protocol.seen_labels: Mask model outputs and TEST rows to the current seen classes
stagewise_protocol.selection: Earliest completed physical source per dataset/method/seed, never by metric
